questions.question: Which request retrieves the current representation of invoice 17?
questions.explanation: GET asks the server to transfer a representation of the target resource.

questions.question: A POST creates /reports/4 synchronously. Which response describes that outcome and identifies the new resource?
questions.explanation: 201 signals successful creation, and Location identifies the created resource.

questions.question: A server chooses to tell an authenticated caller that they lack permission to export a report. Which status matches?
questions.explanation: 403 indicates the server understood the request but refuses to fulfill it.

questions.question: A successful request should return no response content. Which status explicitly conveys that?
questions.explanation: 204 signals successful handling with no response content.

questions.question: Which methods are defined as safe by HTTP? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: GET and HEAD have read-only semantics from the client's perspective.

questions.question: Which request header identifies the media type of a JSON request body?
questions.explanation: Content-Type describes the media type of the content being sent.

questions.question: A target allows GET and HEAD but refuses PUT as an unsupported method. Which status specifically fits?
questions.explanation: 405 indicates the method is known but is unsupported for that target.

questions.question: The API rejects a caller who sent too many requests in a rate-limit window. Which response status fits?
questions.explanation: 429 tells the caller the request exceeded a rate limit.

questions.question: Which response header carries an authentication challenge for a 401 response?
questions.explanation: WWW-Authenticate advertises how the client can authenticate to the origin server.

questions.question: Among these methods, which are defined as idempotent by HTTP? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Repeating an identical PUT or DELETE has the same intended effect as sending it once.

questions.question: A browser has a saved ETag and wants the server to send the representation only if that tag no longer matches. Which request header fits?
questions.explanation: If-None-Match makes the request conditional on the representation not matching a supplied tag.

questions.question: A client sends PUT with If-Match, and the supplied validator no longer matches. The server rejects the update. Which status fits?
questions.explanation: 412 indicates the server rejected the request because a stated precondition was false.

questions.question: Which HTTP method does a browser use for a CORS preflight?
questions.explanation: A preflight is an OPTIONS request that asks whether the cross-origin request is allowed.

questions.question: A server queued a lengthy export and plans to process it later. Which response conveys acceptance while the export remains pending?

options.b: 202 Accepted with a job status URL
options.c: 204 No Content to report a finished download

questions.explanation: 202 signals that the server accepted the request for processing and may provide a status resource.

questions.question: A POST starts a payment. Which design choices help prevent a duplicate charge if the client retries after a timeout? Select all that apply.

options.a: Reuse the same idempotency key for the same logical operation
options.b: Generate a new key on every retry
options.c: Record the key and payment outcome atomically
options.d: Use the payment amount alone as a unique key

questions.explanation: A stable request key plus atomic persistence ties retries to the original outcome.

questions.question: Which Cache-Control directive tells caches to avoid storing the response?
questions.explanation: no-store forbids storing the response. no-cache requires validation before reuse.

questions.question: A feed uses a stable sort order and needs to continue after the last result without an offset. Which pagination input fits?

options.a: A cursor identifying the last sort position
options.c: The total number of rows only
options.d: A page index interpreted as a row offset

questions.explanation: A cursor captures the continuation position in the sort order.

questions.question: An endpoint accepts only JSON and receives an XML body. Which response specifically reports unsupported request content type?
questions.explanation: 415 means the server rejected the request content format.

questions.question: Which response header tells caches that content selection depends on Accept-Language?
questions.explanation: Vary identifies request header fields that affect selection of the cached response.

questions.question: Which authenticated write cases should be tested separately to exercise distinct server behavior? Select all that apply.

options.a: A valid request from a permitted caller
options.b: A valid request from a caller without permission
options.c: Invalid input from a permitted caller
options.d: Only repeated runs of the same successful request

questions.explanation: These cases exercise success, authorization failure, and input validation separately.
